transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: requestPermission publishes interaction:permission-requested. presentation is native-tui only when there is no decide handler and unhandled is defer; otherwise host-ui.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: Host approved becomes allowed and denied becomes denied. No handler and not defer resolves denied immediately.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: tool_call_update in_progress or completed settles that call as allowed. Prompt end, transport close, dispose, and a repeated request settle unknown.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: Elicitation publishes question-requested. Accept on a non-url form publishes answered. URL accept waits for complete. decline and cancel publish cancelled. Missing responder defaults to decline. Other actions and throws publish failed. Prompt success settles pending URL elicitations as superseded; prompt failure settles failed.
